# Wheelr — free online wheel spinner

Wheelr is a free web app that spins a customizable wheel and picks one entry at
random. Type in names, prizes or options, press spin, and the wheel stops on a
winner in front of everyone watching.

It requires no account, no installation and no payment. The same application also
ships as a free Android app on Google Play:
https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=xyz.wheelr.app

## What people use it for

- Raffles and prize giveaways, live on stream or at an event
- Picking a random student, speaker or volunteer
- Deciding a yes/no question when nobody wants to commit
- Choosing dinner, a movie, a workout or a chore
- Assigning tasks or speaking order in a team meeting
- Spin-to-win promo wheels for shops and landing pages

## Features

- **Entries**: add, edit, shuffle and remove names or options; save them as presets.
- **Up to 4 wheels at once**: group several wheels and show 1–4 of them side by side, each with its own entries and settings.
- **Three views**: classic wheel, linear (slot-machine style) and cards.
- **Visual customization**: colour palettes, per-slice colours, background image or colour, a centre logo or centre text, and a choice of fonts.
- **Sound**: rotation sound, countdown sound and a victory sound, all replaceable with your own audio.
- **Countdown**: an optional 3-2-1 countdown before the wheel starts, for suspense on stream.
- **Winner effects**: fire, cartoon fire, confetti, fireworks and applause.
- **Pointer styles**: several pointer shapes to match the look of the event.
- **Sharing**: publish a wheel as a read-only public link that anyone can open without an account.
- **Cloud sync (optional)**: sign in to keep wheels available on other devices; without signing in nothing leaves the device.
- **Offline-friendly**: the Android app works without a connection.

## How a spin works

Entries are drawn as equal slices. The spin adds a large random rotation, taken
from the browser's cryptographic random generator (`crypto.getRandomValues`), and
the winner is whichever slice sits under the pointer when the wheel stops. Nothing
is pre-selected before the animation and there is no weighting, so every entry has
the same chance.

## Getting started

1. Open https://www.wheelr.xyz/
2. Add your entries in the names panel (or start from a template).
3. Optionally set colours, background, centre logo, sounds and countdown.
4. Press spin and announce the winner.

## Pricing

Free. The website carries no ads. The Android app shows a rewarded video ad when
unlocking a ready-made template and an occasional full-screen ad between spins.
Donations are optional and are what keep the project running.

## Links

- Guide and examples: https://www.wheelr.xyz/info
- Templates: https://www.wheelr.xyz/templates

# How to use Wheelr

Wheelr turns random picks into something an audience can watch: giveaways, team
moments and fast decisions, made clear and fair. This page is the full guide.

## How to use Wheelr step by step

1. **Open Wheelr and pick your mode.** Decide whether you need one wheel or a multi-wheel layout (up to 4 wheels) for a more complex event.
2. **Add participants or options.** Insert names, prizes or tasks in the entries list. Keep labels short so they stay readable while spinning.
3. **Save presets.** Create separate configurations (for example Junior Draw, Senior Draw, Gold Prizes) and switch between them instantly during the event.
4. **Customize the visual identity.** Set slice colours, add a background image and configure the centre with a logo or text.
5. **Choose the wheel font.** Pick the typeface that matches your brand or the tone of the event.
6. **Set audio for suspense.** Upload rotation, victory and countdown sounds to make each draw feel like a live show.
7. **Configure the countdown.** Enable a 3-2-1 countdown before the spin to build anticipation on stream, in class or at an office event.
8. **Spin and announce the result.** Let the wheel stop on its own, then show the winner on screen for a transparent draw.
9. **Repeat quickly.** For multi-phase sessions, load the next preset or switch wheel instead of retyping every name.

## Real-life examples

- **Yes or No wheel.** Two friends spent twenty minutes on "should we order sushi?". One spin, one answer, evening saved. The fastest way to stop overthinking.
- **Who does the cleaning.** In a shared flat, every name goes on the wheel and the spinner decides who handles dishes, vacuum and trash. No arguing, no bias.
- **Who speaks first in a meeting.** A remote team built a speaking-order wheel for standups; the spin breaks the silence and meetings start on time.
- **Who wins the giveaway.** A streamer needs a trusted draw: one spin, the audience sees a fair result live, and the giveaway feels transparent and professional.
- **Community raffle night.** A local group entered participant names and announced a winner in under a minute, with no forms to fill in.
- **Shop promo day.** A store ran a spin-to-win corner at the checkout: customers won discounts or gifts and shared the moment on social media.

## Live social media scenarios

- **Twitch giveaway.** Add eligible usernames from chat and spin live for a sub-only reward, game key or merch drop.
- **Instagram Live challenge picker.** Prepare entries from story or post comments and spin for a shoutout, discount code or the next challenge slot.
- **TikTok LIVE winner reveal.** Run the draw in real time with a short countdown before each spin to build suspense and watch time.
- **Facebook Live community draw.** Import names from comments for weekly community prizes, quiz rewards or participation draws.

## Where Wheelr fits

- **At work:** standups, workshops, retros and onboarding — pick speakers, tasks or prizes quickly and transparently.
- **With friends:** movie night, games, challenges, or "who buys the coffee?" — when nobody can choose, the wheel decides.
- **In class:** pick a student at random, assign turns, run quick learning games.

## FAQ

**Is Wheelr completely free?**
Yes. No registration, no credit card, no hidden fees. You can spin, customize colours, add sounds and run draws at no cost.

**How do I make draws fairer?**
Clean the list, remove unwanted duplicates and use Shuffle Names before each spin. The spin itself uses the browser's cryptographic random source, so no entry is favoured.

**Can I use it in livestreams or classrooms?**
Yes. It is built for public moments: everyone sees the same result at the same time.

**Can I use Wheelr as a yes or no wheel?**
Yes — add "Yes" and "No" as the only two entries, or start from the Yes or No template.

**How many wheels can I manage at once?**
Up to 4, each with its own participants, colours and settings, switchable instantly during an event.

**How do I make it look like my brand?**
Customize palette, background, centre logo, fonts, effects and audio.

**Do I need an account?**
No. An account only adds cloud sync between devices.

# Privacy policy

Last updated: 8 August 2026. This policy covers both the website at wheelr.xyz and
the Wheelr Android app. Contact for any privacy or deletion request:
annyone.any@gmail.com.

## The short version

- You can use Wheelr without an account. If you do, your wheels stay on your device and are never sent to us.
- If you sign in, your wheels are synced to our cloud so you can reach them from other devices.
- The Android app shows ads through Google AdMob, which collects advertising data.
- We do not sell your data and we do not build advertising profiles ourselves.

## What is collected

**If you never sign in:** nothing is sent to us. Wheels, names, colours, images and
sounds live only in the browser's local storage and IndexedDB, or in the app's local
storage. Deleting the app or clearing site data erases them permanently.

**If you create an account or sign in:** we process your email address and, with
Google Sign-In, the basic profile information Google releases. Authentication is
handled by Firebase Authentication; we never see or store your password. The content
of the wheels you sync — entries, palettes, images, sounds and settings — is stored
in Google Cloud Firestore under an identifier tied to your account.

**In the Android app:** Google AdMob collects data to serve and measure ads,
including the device advertising ID, device and network information, and ad
interactions. AdMob acts as an independent controller for this.

**On the website only:** Vercel Analytics and Vercel Speed Insights count page views
and measure loading performance. They are aggregate, cookie-less and do not identify
you, and they are disabled entirely inside the Android app.

## Shared wheels are public

A shared wheel is readable by anyone with the link or its ID, with no account. That
is the point of the feature, but it means anything on a shared wheel — including
people's names — stops being private. Sharing can be stopped at any time by deleting
the wheel from your account.

## Legal basis (GDPR)

- Art. 6(1)(b) — performing the service you asked for: your account and wheel syncing.
- Art. 6(1)(a) — consent: personalized advertising, asked on first launch and changeable later.
- Art. 6(1)(f) — legitimate interest: aggregate website measurement and keeping the service secure.

## Advertising

Ads appear in two places in the app: an optional video you choose to watch to unlock
a ready-made wheel, and an occasional full-screen ad between spins. In regions that
require it, Google's consent form asks about personalized ads on first launch;
declining still shows ads, but non-personalized ones.

## Retention and your rights

Synced wheels are kept until you delete them or delete your account. If you are in
the EU/EEA or the UK you can ask to access, correct, export or delete your personal
data, object to processing, or withdraw consent — write to annyone.any@gmail.com and
we respond within 30 days. You may also complain to your national data protection
authority.

## Deleting your data

Delete an individual wheel in the app to remove it from the cloud. To delete
everything, open the account panel (person icon in the header) and choose *Delete
account*: after confirming your identity, the account and every synced wheel —
including shared ones, whose links stop working — are erased immediately and
permanently. Wheels saved only on the device are unaffected. Deletion can also be
requested by writing from the account's email address to annyone.any@gmail.com.

## Children

Wheelr is not directed at children under 13 (or under 16 where local law sets that
age) and we do not knowingly collect their personal data.

# Chore Wheel

Every shared house has the same argument, and it is never really about the dishes. A wheel settles it without anyone having to be the one who decided: spin, read the result, it is done.

## On the wheel

- Dishes
- Bins out
- Bathroom
- Hoovering
- Laundry
- Cooking
- Food shop
- Day off

The wheel can be spun directly at https://www.wheelr.xyz/templates/chore-wheel — no account, no
installation. Copying it creates your own editable wheel; the entries, colours,
sounds and effects are all replaceable.

## Chores or people — pick a side

Put the chores on the wheel and spin once per person, or put the housemates on it and spin once per chore. The second version is better when one job is far worse than the others, because everybody watches that particular spin.

## Make it weekly

Add a "day off" slice so there is something to hope for, and remove each chore once it is assigned so the wheel shares out the whole list. Keep the wheel saved and re-spin it every Sunday — the routine is what stops the argument coming back.

## FAQ

**Can I add or remove chores?**

Yes. Copy the wheel and edit the entries to match your household — the version you make is saved on your device.

**Can I make one chore rarer than the others?**

The odds are just the slices. Repeat the chores you want to come up more often and leave the worst one as a single slice.

# Spin-to-Win Discount Wheel

A discount someone won feels different from a discount they were given. Put your offers on the wheel, let the customer spin it themselves, and a routine promotion turns into thirty seconds of attention.

## On the wheel

- 5% Off
- 10% Off
- 15% Off
- 20% Off
- 30% Off
- 50% Off
- Free Gift
- No Luck

The wheel can be spun directly at https://www.wheelr.xyz/templates/discount-wheel — no account, no
installation. Copying it creates your own editable wheel; the entries, colours,
sounds and effects are all replaceable.

## For a counter, a stall or a stand

Run it on a tablet at the till, on a laptop at a trade stand, or on a screen behind a market stall. Everything lives in the browser and the Android app works offline, which matters at an event where the venue wi-fi does not.

## Control what you are giving away

The odds are the slices: make the deep discount one slice out of twelve and the small ones repeat. Adding a "next time" or "free shipping" slice keeps the wheel honest while capping what a single spin can cost you.

## FAQ

**Can I control how often the big discount comes up?**

Yes, through the slices themselves. Every slice of equal size has an equal chance, so repeating the smaller offers and leaving one slice for the big one sets the odds exactly.

**Can I brand the wheel for my shop?**

Colours, background, fonts, a centre logo and the sounds are all replaceable, so the wheel can be made to match your shop rather than looking like a generic tool.

# Icebreaker Questions Wheel

Icebreakers fail when the facilitator picks the question and everyone can tell it was picked. A wheel takes that away: the question arrives by chance, the room reacts to the wheel instead of to you, and the first answer comes faster.

## On the wheel

- Favorite food?
- Best concert ever?

installation. Copying it creates your own editable wheel; the entries, colours,
sounds and effects are all replaceable.

## For meetings, onboarding and workshops

Spin once at the top of a recurring meeting and go round the room, or spin per person so everybody gets a different question. It works the same on a projector in a room and shared on a call, and two minutes is usually all it needs to take.

## Write questions your team would answer

The stock questions are a starting point; the good version of this wheel is the one a team wrote themselves. Keep the questions light and answerable in a sentence — anything that needs a considered answer stops being an icebreaker and becomes a meeting.

## FAQ

**Does it work for remote teams?**

Yes. Share your screen and spin, or publish the wheel as a public link so everyone on the call opens the same one in their own browser.

**Can I use my own icebreaker questions?**

Copy the wheel and replace the entries with your own. The wheel is saved on your device, so the same set is ready for every following meeting.

# Never Have I Ever Wheel

Never have I ever stalls the moment somebody has to invent the next statement. Put them on a wheel and the game keeps its rhythm: spin, read it out, watch who gives themselves away.

## On the wheel

- Sung karaoke sober
- Missed a flight
- Faked knowing a song
- Talked in my sleep
- Ghosted a group chat
- Cried at an advert
- Got lost in my own town
- Texted the wrong person

The wheel can be spun directly at https://www.wheelr.xyz/templates/never-have-i-ever-wheel — no account, no
installation. Copying it creates your own editable wheel; the entries, colours,
sounds and effects are all replaceable.

## The wheel is the host

Nobody has to run the game, which also means nobody can aim a statement at one person in particular. The wheel picking at random is what keeps it light — everyone is exposed by chance rather than by the person whose turn it was.

## Build your own set

The default statements are mild on purpose. Copy the wheel and write your own for the group you are playing with, and keep more than one version — a work-party wheel and a close-friends wheel are not the same list.

## FAQ

**How many players does it work with?**

Any number. The wheel only picks the statement; how you score it — fingers down, points, forfeits — is up to the group.

**Can everyone see the wheel at once?**

Share it as a read-only public link and everyone opens the same wheel in their own browser, or put one screen in the middle of the table.

# Prize Wheel for Giveaways

A giveaway is only as good as the moment the winner is announced. This prize wheel puts that moment on screen: the prizes are visible before the spin, the wheel slows down in front of everybody, and the result is impossible to quietly edit afterwards.

## On the wheel

- €50 Gift Card
- Free T-Shirt
- Sticker Pack
- Mystery Box
- 20% Discount
- Free Shipping
- Try Again
- Grand Prize

The wheel can be spun directly at https://www.wheelr.xyz/templates/prize-wheel — no account, no
installation. Copying it creates your own editable wheel; the entries, colours,
sounds and effects are all replaceable.

## Built for an audience

The wheel is designed to be shown, not just used: a countdown before the spin, a fireworks effect on the winner, and sounds you can swap for your own. Hide the interface chrome and the wheel fills the screen, which is what you want when it is sitting in a stream layout or on a projector at an event.

## Prizes, not just names

Put the prizes on the wheel and spin once per winner, or put the entrants on it and spin once per prize — both work. Winners can be removed automatically after each spin so nobody wins twice, and the winners list keeps the record of who drew what.

## FAQ

**Is the prize wheel fair?**

Every slice of the same size has exactly the same chance, and the outcome comes from a cryptographic random source rather than a seeded sequence. Nothing about the result can be set in advance.

**Can my audience see the wheel without installing anything?**

Yes. Publish the wheel as a read-only public link and anyone can open it in a browser, with no account. It is also what you share after the draw as a record of the entries.

## Links

- This wheel: https://www.wheelr.xyz/templates/prize-wheel
- All templates: https://www.wheelr.xyz/templates

# Random Animal Wheel

Give a child a random animal and you have a game: act it out, draw it, make its noise, say three facts about it. The wheel is the part that keeps it fair and stops anyone choosing the easy one.

## On the wheel

- Fox
- Elephant
- Penguin
- Tiger
- Octopus
- Owl
- Kangaroo
- Dolphin
- Panda
- Crocodile

The wheel can be spun directly at https://www.wheelr.xyz/templates/random-animal-wheel — no account, no
installation. Copying it creates your own editable wheel; the entries, colours,
sounds and effects are all replaceable.

## Charades, drawing and guessing games

The wheel hands out the animal so the person whose turn it is does not get to pick something easy. It works the same for a class of thirty and for two children at a kitchen table, and needs nothing but a screen.

## Match it to what you are teaching

Copy the wheel and swap in the animals from the topic you are on — habitats, farm animals, minibeasts, the ones in the book you are reading. A wheel built around a lesson is worth more than a generic one.

## FAQ

**Can I use pictures instead of names?**

Yes. Each slice can carry its own image, which is what you want for children who are not reading yet.

**Can I make the wheel easier for younger children?**

Fewer entries means bigger slices and simpler choices. A six-animal wheel is easier to play with than a twenty-animal one.

## Links

Twenty-six slices is a lot for one wheel. Removing letters you do not need makes the rest larger, and the linear and card views show the same wheel with more room for each label.

## Paste the register and go

Add the whole list in one go rather than typing names one at a time, shuffle it, and start spinning. A teacher can set this up between two lessons, and the same wheel stays saved for the rest of the term.

## Nobody twice, or everybody eventually

Remove each name after it is drawn and the wheel works through the class without repeats — which is how you make sure the quiet students get their turn too. Leave the names in and it stays a lottery, better for handing out a single prize.

## FAQ

**How many names can the picker hold?**

A full class fits comfortably. Past roughly thirty entries the labels on the wheel get thin, so very long lists are easier to read split across a few wheels.

**Can I stop a name from being picked twice?**

Yes. Turn on removing the winner after each spin and each name is drawn at most once, so consecutive spins work through the whole list.

- 1

## When the draw needs witnesses

Raffle tickets, bingo calls, lottery-style draws, picking a seat or a locker: any time the number decides who gets something, being able to see it drawn matters more than the speed. The wheel slows the moment down deliberately, and the winners list keeps the order the numbers came out in.

## Set your own range

Copy the wheel and replace the entries with whatever range you need — 1 to 20, ticket numbers, the numbers still in play. Remove each number after it is drawn and the wheel works through the range without repeating, which is exactly how a bingo caller uses it.

## FAQ

**How is this different from a random number generator?**

The randomness is the same cryptographic source. The difference is that the draw is visible: everyone watching sees the same spin land on the same number, which a generator that prints a number cannot offer.

**Can I draw several numbers without repeats?**

Yes. Turn on removing the winner after each spin and each number is drawn at most once, so repeated spins work through the whole range.

# Secret Santa Wheel

A hat full of folded paper only works when everyone is in the same room. A wheel draws the names in front of whoever is watching — in the office, on a call, or in a group chat with the screen shared.

## On the wheel

- Anna
- Ben
- Chiara
- David
- Elena
- Marco
- Nina
- Paul

The wheel can be spun directly at https://www.wheelr.xyz/templates/secret-santa-wheel — no account, no
installation. Copying it creates your own editable wheel; the entries, colours,
sounds and effects are all replaceable.

## How to run the draw

Put every participant on the wheel and spin once for each giver, removing each name as it comes out so nobody is assigned twice. The winners list keeps the order the names were drawn in, which is the record you check when somebody forgets who they had.

## Keeping it secret

The catch with a public draw is that it is public. For a genuinely secret exchange, spin privately for each person and tell them their name individually — the wheel is doing the randomising, not the announcing.

## FAQ

**Can the wheel avoid pairing someone with themselves?**

Remove the giver’s own name from the wheel before their spin, and remove each drawn name afterwards. That is the whole trick, and it takes a second per person.

**Does everyone need an account?**

No. The wheel runs in any browser with no signup, and a read-only public link lets everyone watch the same one without signing in.

## Links

- This wheel: https://www.wheelr.xyz/templates/secret-santa-wheel
- All templates: https://www.wheelr.xyz/templates
- Wheel app: https://www.wheelr.xyz/

# Yes or No Wheel

Some questions do not deserve another twenty minutes of thinking. Spin the wheel, read the answer, move on. The result comes from your browser’s cryptographic random source, so it is genuinely unpredictable — nothing here is weighted or seeded.

## On the wheel

- Yes
- No
- Yes
- No
- Yes
- No

The wheel can be spun directly at https://www.wheelr.xyz/templates/yes-or-no-wheel — no account, no
installation. Copying it creates your own editable wheel; the entries, colours,
sounds and effects are all replaceable.

## When a wheel beats a coin flip

A coin gives you a private answer you can quietly ignore. A wheel spun in front of a group is a decision everyone watched happen, which is why it settles arguments that a coin does not. It is also slower on purpose: the three seconds of spinning are what make the answer feel earned rather than arbitrary.

## Change the odds, or the answers

Copy the wheel and it becomes yours. Add more Yes slices than No ones if you already know which way you are leaning. Replace the two options entirely — "do it" and "not today", the names of two restaurants, two people who could take the task. The wheel does not care what is written on it.

## FAQ

**Is the yes or no wheel really random?**

Yes. The spin uses your browser’s cryptographic random number generator, the same source used for security keys. There is no seed, no pattern and no way to predict where it stops.

**Can I add a third option like "maybe"?**

Copy the wheel and add as many entries as you like. A third slice reading "ask again tomorrow" is a popular addition for questions that are not urgent.

## Links

- This wheel: https://www.wheelr.xyz/templates/yes-or-no-wheel
- All templates: https://www.wheelr.xyz/templates
- Wheel app: https://www.wheelr.xyz/
